title: Effectiveness of a Schema Therapy on Anxiety in Patients With Multiple Sclerosis
brief_summary: It is a multicentric randomized and controlled study comparing a Scheme therapy program versus local practice in RRMS patients with anxiety. Patients will assist to twenty once-weekly group sessions with a 6-month follow up after the end of the programme. The main criteria is the impact of schema therapy on anxiety evaluated by the questionnaires at the end of the program and at the end of the 6-month follow-up.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* subject has relapsing remitting MS
* anxiety (score \>26 at the BAI scale)
* history of psychotic disorders
* history of cognitive deficiency
* use anti-depressant in the past 3 months
* history of relapse in the past 3 month
* expanded Disability Status Scale score less than 6
* ability reading and writing Persian
* Non hospitalized

Exclusion Criteria:

* history of psychotic disorders
* history of cognitive deficiency
* use anti-depressant in the past 3 months
* history of relapse in the past 3 month
